_about: How long each one-shot hunter mechanic animation is raised for (hunters/mechanics.rs). A gimmick raises the cue in its own hook at the real gameplay event (a battery taken, a tripwire hit, a fake cue sent...) and the host keeps the name on the hunter for `seconds`; the pose it plays is in data/render/hunter_anims.json `states`. Continuous mechanics (reaching for a battery, the music box hold...) have no entry here: they last as long as the gimmick's own state. `net_ttl` is how long a guest keeps the name the host last sent when no newer frame arrives. A cue never moves or freezes the hunter: the pose is laid over the walk.
